title: Spectra Fintech certification manifesto
description: High-level acceptance and test manifest for onboarding Spectra (fintech customer) model endpoints. Focus is on customer-pinned prompts, private PII-labelled datasets, measurable acceptance criteria for both quality and production SLOs, and a regression baseline + sign-off flow. This doc is intentionally prescriptive so Solutions, Applied ML, and DevEx can run a reproducible certification run and hand off to Customer Success.
pinned_prompts: Transaction classify: 'Customer message: "{text}". Classify the transaction type into one of: payment, refund, chargeback, fee, transfer. Output only the label. If ambiguous, output 'uncertain' and top-2 probable labels with probabilities.'

Explain alert: 'Given transaction record {txn_json}, explain in plain English why the system flagged it for review. Keep to 2-3 bullet points and cite which fields contributed (amount/merchant/mcc/ip/velocity). Do not invent facts.'
Customer summary (KYC): 'Summarize the customer's recent account activity in 3 bullets suitable for a human reviewer. Highlight anomalies and cite exact transactions by id. Avoid speculation.'

Regulatory extraction: 'From the text below, extract the PCI-relevant fields: card_last4, card_type, transaction_date, amount, merchant_name. Output a JSON object only. If field not present, set null.'

Merchant risk delta: 'Given two consecutive 24-hour windows of merchant activity, list the top 3 MAJOR risk signals that have increased (brief sentence each) and an estimated impact ordinal: low/medium/high.'
Paraphrase robustness check: 'Rewrite the following suspicious-transaction description in 5 different natural-language paraphrases that preserve meaning and length roughly.'
Escalation script: 'Draft a one-paragraph message an agent can send to a customer explaining why a payment was declined and next steps; maintain professional tone and avoid legal advice.'
Sanity-check prompt: 'Is any of the input text clearly PII (names, emails, phone, SSN)? Output yes/no and list the detected token types.'
private_datasets: spectra_txn_annot_v2 (s3://redwood-private/spectra/txn_v2.parquet) - 28k rows, 12 granular labels, annot schema: transaction_type, fraud_label, reviewer_notes, highlighted_fields. Contains hashed account ids and tokenized merchant strings. PII present in free-text notes.
spectra_kb_redacted_2024-08 (gs://redwood-pvt/spectra/kb_redacted.jsonl) - support transcripts redacted for PHI/PII, used for summarization prompts. ~4.3k sessions.
synthetic-augment-2024 (local/secure) - paraphrase augmentations of flagged transactions to stress-test robustness. 50k synthetic variants derived from txn_annot_v2.
spectra_holdout_q3 (s3://redwood-private/spectra/holdout_q3.parquet) - temporal holdout set (Aug-Sep 2024) for regression runs; 6k rows annotated by Spectrum review team.
privacy-note: all datasets live in private bucket with KMS key customer-spectra-kms-01; DO NOT move to hosted evaluation environment without explicit customer authorization and DAC signoff.
acceptance_criteria: Quality: macro-F1 for transaction_type >= 0.92 on spectra_holdout_q3 (label-imbalances accounted via weighted averaging).
Hallucination/control: less than 1% of outputs for extraction tasks contain tokens not present in input (measured by token overlap heuristic).
Latency: p95 generation latency <= 220ms for 32-token responses on dedicated medium instance profile (quantized-8), tested with 50 concurrent clients.
Reliability: end-to-end uptime >= 99.5% during a 72-hour soak test under traffic profile provided by Spectra (avg qps 12, burst to 60).
Cost: average inference cost per 1k tokens must not exceed $0.45 under current runtime config; Optimize suggestions may be accepted if tradeoff documented.
Safety: sensitive PI/PCI redaction detection recall >= 0.985 on a labeled redaction test split. Any false negatives require incident mitigation steps agreed with CS/Legal.
Behavioral: paraphrase-robustness top-1 label agreement >= 94% across 5 paraphrases per sample in synthetic-augment-2024 subset.
regression_tests: Seeded confusion matrix run: run full classification eval with 10 fixed seeds and record mean/std dev of macro-F1 and per-class recall.
Temporal drift check: compare model metrics on holdout_q3 vs holdout_q2; flag if drop in macro-F1 > 2.5 points.
Paraphrase robustness sweep: use synthetic-augment-2024 to get label stability curve across temperature 0.0-0.9; record agreement at each temp.
Extraction fidelity: run extraction prompts on 2k labeled samples and compute exact-match on extracted fields; threshold defined above.
Adversarial prompt injection: run 500 adversarially formatted prompts (special tokens, escaped JSON) to ensure model returns structured JSON only when asked and not freeform commentary.
Latency soak: 72-hour soak with production-like batching enabled; capture p50/p95/p99 and memory/GC anomalies from runtime tracing.
Regression alert integration: generate and push nightly regression report to #applied-ml-regressions and trigger Linear ticket if any criterion fails.
signoff_steps: 1) Applied ML runs certification suite and uploads artifact bundle to GH release (metrics CSVs, raw predictions, evaluation notebooks).
2) Solutions Engineering verifies deployment config and canary routing policy in staging (include routing policy id).
3) Security reviews dataset access logs and approves private bucket access; Legal must sign off on redaction sufficiency.
4) Product/PM reviews tradeoff doc if any acceptance criteria unmet but mitigations proposed (e.g., slight latency increase for cost reduction).
5) Customer Success (Spectra lead) performs user-acceptance run with 200 live shadow requests and signs acceptance form (digital sign-off link in linked_artifacts).
6) Engineering creates a scheduled regression job and a rollback playbook; SRE adds monitoring runbook and alert thresholds to Redwood Console.
7) Final sign-off: director Applied ML + solutions lead + security + spectra-customer-rep must initial sign-off in the Confluence attestation page.
operational_notes: Use dedicated GPU pool tag 'spectra-cert' for repeatability. Avoid autoscale rules that change instance family during certification runs.
When running hosted evals use private VPC connector and ensure egress is disabled to external buckets. All artifacts should be written to S3 path with customer KMS key.
Labeling corrections: if reviewer corrections exceed 1.5% of sampled holdout, pause certification and run a relabeling sprint (assign to Spectra review team).
Auditability: keep raw prompt->response pairs for 180 days in secure logs; strip PII from logs unless explicitly permitted for debugging under ticketed process.
open_questions: Does Spectra want the 'explain alert' output to include confidence scores per bullet? (Product to confirm)
Are we permitted to use partially de-identified email hashes in the holdout for retrieval-style features? (Security/Legal)

Who is the single point of contact at Spectra for emergency rollback outside business hours? (CS identified but need confirmation)
